parameters:
The "Viper Demon" that spread its poison and drove a village
to ruin. Just how great a threat could it be...
list._original:
毒を撒き散らし村を壊滅に追い込んだという「毒蛇魔人」。
一体どれほどの脅威なのでしょう…

parameters:
Oh my～ Lorentia, that's not like you at all. You're the
Royal Knights' most combat-specialized member. A demon or
two, you could wrap up just like that.
list._original:
あーらロレンチア、らしくないわね。
王宮騎士の中でも特に戦闘技術に特化したアナタなら、
魔人の一体や二体、ぱぱーっと始末できるでしょうに。

parameters:
Royal Knight Sazanna, that depends entirely on how the
Poison Resistance Potion I requested from you is coming
along... How is your progress?
list._original:
王宮騎士サザンナ、それはアナタに依頼した
毒耐性ポーションの仕上がり次第なんですが…
進捗はいかがです？

parameters:
Finished ages ago. And it's my greatest masterpiece, no
less!
list._original: とっくに完成してるわよ。しかも最高傑作！

parameters:
One dose gives you complete immunity to poison and corrosion
for "about six months".
list._original: 一本飲めば毒や腐食への完全耐性が「半年くらい」持続するわ。

parameters: Six months...? Isn't that far too long?

Aww～ forgive me, adjusting the concentration on a
full-immunity potion is tricky! But, but, the demon always
has underlings in tow, so it'll come in handy for mopping up
stragglers after the subjugation, right?
list._original:
ああん許してよ、完全耐性ポーションは濃度の調整が難しいの！
でもでも、魔人は毎回取り巻きを従えているし、
討伐後の残党狩りにも有用でしょ？

parameters:
True, it beats drinking a potion before every battle... But
with an effect that potent, the side effects must be just as
severe. I won't end up an invalid, will I?
list._original:
確かに、戦闘のたびにポーションを飲むよりは…
でもそれだけの効果、副作用も酷いはず。
廃人になったりしません？

parameters:
There shouldn't be any major side effects, but... there's
just one thing to watch out for!
list._original: 大きな副作用はないはずけど…一点だけ注意して！

parameters:
The complete poison immunity it grants nullifies every
external factor that affects your condition. In other words,
ordinary medicine gets shut right out.
list._original:
付与される毒への完全耐性は体調に影響を与える外的要因を
すべてを無効化する代物。
つまり、一般的なお薬なんかもシャットアウトされちゃうの。

parameters:
To use household remedies as an example... sleeping pills or
laxatives, maybe? Do you take anything like that regularly?
list._original: 常備薬で例えれば…睡眠薬や下剤とかかしら？普段飲んでる？

parameters: Contraceptives won't work on you either!
list._original: 避妊薬なんかも効かなくなっちゃうわ！

parameters: My, my, isn't that a serious problem!?
list._original: あらあら、これは大問題ではなくて！？

parameters:
...Why do you look so pleased? Rest assured, no "accident"
of the sort you're imagining will occur while I'm on my
mission.
list._original:
…何故嬉しそうなんですか。
任務中にアナタの想像しているような「アクシデント」は
発生しませんので、ご安心を。

parameters:
Well, true. Even among the palace crowd, there's hardly a
man who could measure up to you～...
list._original:
ま、そうよね。王宮の関係者でもアナタに釣り合う男は
見つかりそうにないし～…

parameters: Are we done? We can discuss private matters another time.
list._original: もういいですか、プライベートな話はまた今度。

parameters:
"Another time" surely means six months from now at the
earliest, doesn't it? I'll be lonely.
list._original: 「今度」ってきっと半年以上先でしょ？寂しくなるわね。

parameters: Take care out there, my adorable Lorentia-chan.
list._original: 気をつけていってらっしゃい、かわいいロレンチアちゃん。
